digest.component_or_area: event-derivation metrics reader over durable ticket event store
propositions: Read-only derivation metrics (attempts_per_ticket, first_pass_rate, rework_within_days, reopen_recovery, revert_recovery) over durable ticket event store must distinguish raw event files (for multi-occurrence data) from compiled terminal state (for single-value sufficiency).

Raw-event metrics (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) must reuse existing reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event, RETIRED_SUFFIX) to sort chronologically, include compaction-retired events, and skip SNAPSHOT files; state-based metrics (first_pass, revert_recovery) read only terminal values from reduce_ticket.
Each metric returns None for empty range (→ Unavailable) and 0 for populated range with zero qualifying events; metrics register with source=structural and confidence=high.

Rework-within-days counts closed→open→closed transitions within n days; revert_recovery filters reverts by target_event_type (STATUS or COMMITS only); first_pass_rate uses absence of last_reopened_at as terminal signal.
